purpose: Prioritize validated macro-seeds as generalizable parameter-training candidates while preserving detailed evidence in vector memory.

conversion.rule: Never train mere recitation of a macro-seed. Expand each validated macro-seed into diverse application tasks, counterexamples, negative cases, transfer tasks and adversarial variants.
conversion.target: Behavioral application of the invariant on unseen tasks without retrieval.

proof: Parametric incorporation requires fresh no-RAG gain, transfer gain, adapter ablation evidence and no critical regression.
priority: Macro-seeds may receive higher curation priority than case-specific lessons, but priority never bypasses evidence gates.
